items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020

ctx.x: Yes. I’m in the same position with gigs you know. If I could play them I would but it’s not happening now so I’ll do more reading. All right so I’m going to pause our recording and I want to thank you for our time today, it was very, very interesting for me.
Thanks, Monk, it was fun. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
